source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A Student/Student event pairs one adult Pro/Am Student Competitor with another; it is not open to amateur dancers who compete at the Open Amateur proficiency level.

requirement: A future NDCA body profile must enforce verified participant roles (two adult Pro/Am Student Competitors) and the eligibility rules before accepting a Student/Student entry. Today the Studio/Custom format 'Studio/Custom: Student pair' accepts any two participants and is labelled as a DanceFlow format, never as the NDCA division.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: an NDCA entry format with a role set and eligibility checks, enforced in TypeScript and SQL together (drift guard), once Competition OS offers an NDCA profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed before activation. NOT IMPLEMENTED and a BLOCKER for any future NDCA body profile that offers Student/Student. Studio/Custom keeps the flexible custom roles (allowedRolesForFormat default branch) by owner decision OD-19 option C; the profile roles stored for the format are never read by the quote path. Re-read in the pinned PDF on 2026-11-23.
